## Calendar

`import { Calendar, RangeCalendar } from '@jovertical/mise-design-system'`

A month grid to pick a day from. The one a `DatePicker` renders inside its popover, and the one most call sites want; `type="multiple"` picks several separate days, and `RangeCalendar` a contiguous span.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `captionLayout` | `'label' \| 'dropdown' \| 'dropdown-months' \| 'dropdown-years'` | `'label'` | `label` names the month; the dropdown layouts swap the month, the year or both for a native select, for a date far from today (a birth date, an expiry). |

Also takes: bits-ui `Calendar.Root` props except `children`, `child`.

### `RangeCalendar`

A contiguous span of days, for reporting windows and stay lengths. The first click sets `start`; the second sets `end` and closes the span.

| --- | --- | --- | --- |

Also takes: bits-ui `RangeCalendar.Root` props except `children`, `child`.

Types: `CalendarCaptionLayout` (`'label' | 'dropdown' | 'dropdown-months' | 'dropdown-years'`).

## NumberInput

`import { NumberInput, NumberInputField } from '@jovertical/mise-design-system'`

A number typed into a text field, never `type="number"`: the native one has 8px spinners drawn differently in every engine, a scroll wheel that changes a quantity under a passing pointer, "1e" accepted as a number in progress, and a selection API that throws.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `format` | `'integer' \| 'decimal' \| 'currency'` | `'decimal'` | `integer` takes whole numbers; `decimal` takes up to `precision` places; `currency` speaks minor units: `value` is an integer count of cents, shown with two places, and only two can be typed, because a third has no cent to land in. Everything crossing the boundary is then an integer, the units an API uses, and no price arrives as 19.99 and leaves as 1998.9999999999998. |
| `min` | `number` | `0` | The floor, in `value`'s units. A negative one lets a minus sign be typed. |
| `max` | `number` |  | No ceiling when absent. |
| `step` | `number` | `1` | How far ↑, ↓ and the buttons move it, in `value`'s units. |
| `precision` | `number` |  | The most decimal places `decimal` takes. No limit when absent. |
| `clearable` | `boolean` | `true` | An emptied field commits `null`. Off, it commits `min`: for a count where zero is a real answer and the field should never be blank. |
| `controls` | `boolean` | `false` | − and + either side, inside the field's own fill, so it reads as one control beside the plain inputs around it. Each disables at its end of the range. |
| `prefix` | `string \| Snippet` |  | Ahead of the number: a currency symbol, a unit. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | The height `Input` draws at the same size: `sm` for a dense row. `md` by default. |

Also takes: everything `NumberInputField` takes.

### `NumberInputField`

The field alone: a number typed into a text field, inside an `InputGroup` the caller draws. `NumberInput` is this with its own group, buttons and prefix; reach for the field only when composing another control.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `format` | `'integer' \| 'decimal' \| 'currency'` | `'decimal'` |  |
| `value` | `number \| null` | `null` |  |
| `onValueChange` | `(value: number \| null) => void` |  |  |
| `min` | `number` | `0` |  |
| `max` | `number` |  |  |
| `step` | `number` | `1` |  |
| `precision` | `number` |  |  |
| `clearable` | `boolean` | `true` |  |
| `ref` | `HTMLInputElement \| null` | `null` |  |

Also takes: every `<input>` attribute except `type`, `value`, `min`, `max`, `step`, `prefix`, `children`, `files`, `size`.

Types: `NumberInputFormat` (`'integer' | 'decimal' | 'currency'`).

## Select

`import { Select, SelectContent, SelectGroup, SelectItem, SelectLabel, SelectScrollDownButton, SelectScrollUpButton, SelectSeparator, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@jovertical/mise-design-system'`

Pass `items` (`{ value, label }[]`) so the trigger can show the selected label while the list is closed. bits-ui learns an item's label only when the item renders, and the list renders only when open. Radix kept hidden items mounted for the same purpose.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `'single'` | `'single'` |  |

Also takes: bits-ui `Select.Root` props except `type`; bits-ui `Select.Root` props.

### `SelectContent`

A ring rather than a border, matching every other floating surface.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `portalProps` | `SelectPrimitive.PortalProps` |  |  |

Also takes: bits-ui `Select.Content` props except `child`.

### `SelectGroup`

Also takes: bits-ui `Select.Group` props.

### `SelectItem`

`focus:bg-muted` rather than `--accent`, which is a nav tint and never a hover.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `Snippet` |  |  |

Also takes: bits-ui `Select.Item` props except `child` except `children`.

### `SelectLabel`

Also takes: bits-ui `Select.GroupHeading` props.

### `SelectScrollDownButton`

Also takes: bits-ui `Select.ScrollDownButton` props except `children`, `child`.

### `SelectScrollUpButton`

Also takes: bits-ui `Select.ScrollUpButton` props except `children`, `child`.

### `SelectSeparator`

Also takes: every `<div>` attribute.

### `SelectTrigger`

`w-full` by default: a select sits in a form field beside inputs that are already full width, and `w-fit` made it the one control in the row not to be. Set `class="w-fit"` back for the rarer case. `size="sm"` for a dense row, such as a table cell or a toolbar.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md'` | `'md'` |  |

Also takes: bits-ui `Select.Trigger` props except `child`.

### `SelectValue`

Also takes: bits-ui `Select.Value` props.

## Switch

`import { Switch } from '@jovertical/mise-design-system'`

Bare: pair it with a Label, or a field, when it needs words beside it.

Also takes: bits-ui `Switch.Root` props except `children`, `child`.

## SwitchField

`import { SwitchField } from '@jovertical/mise-design-system'`

A bordered on/off row: what it does on the left, the switch on the right.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` (required) | `string` |  | The switch's id, which the label points at. |
| `label` (required) | `string` |  |  |
| `description` | `string` |  |  |
| `checked` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `onCheckedChange` | `(checked: boolean) => void` |  |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `variant` | `'default' \| 'flush'` | `'default'` | `default` draws its own bordered surface, for a switch that stands alone in a form. |
| `children` | `Snippet` |  | Revealed below the row while the switch is on. |

Also takes: every `<div>` attribute except `children`.

Types: `SwitchFieldVariant` (`'default' | 'flush'`).

## Textarea

`import { Textarea } from '@jovertical/mise-design-system'`

A counter appears only when `maxlength` is set: a bare number counts up towards nothing. `maxlength` stops typing at the ceiling, so falling under `minlength` is the only reachable invalid state, and only once something has been typed. An untouched optional field is not wrong.

Also takes: every `<textarea>` attribute.

## TimePicker

`import { TimePicker } from '@jovertical/mise-design-system'`

Three selects standing in for a clock: hour, minute, and AM/PM.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `Time` |  |  |
| `onValueChange` | `(value: Time) => void` |  |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `hourCycle` | `12 \| 24` | `12` | `12` shows 1–12 and an AM/PM select; `24` shows 00–23 and no period. |
| `minuteStep` | `number` | `1` | The minutes listed, every `minuteStep` from 00. A value between steps keeps its own minute listed, so loading it loses nothing. |

Also takes: every `<div>` attribute except `children`.

## Toggle

`import { Toggle, toggleVariants } from '@jovertical/mise-design-system'`

One on/off control, not a group: reach for `ToggleGroup` the moment a second option joins it. `variant="segmented"` only makes sense inside that group's track; a lone `Toggle` wants `default`, `outline` or `solid`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `'default' \| 'outline' \| 'segmented' \| 'solid'` |  |  |
| `size` | `ToggleSize` |  |  |
| `iconOnly` | `boolean` |  | One glyph and no label: a circle the size of the toggle's height. Needs an `aria-label`. |

Also takes: bits-ui `Toggle.Root` props.

Also exports: `toggleVariants`.

Types: `ToggleSize`, `ToggleVariant` (`'default' | 'outline' | 'segmented' | 'solid'`).

## ToggleGroup

`import { ToggleGroup, ToggleGroupItem } from '@jovertical/mise-design-system'`

A segmented group is a track, not a row of joined buttons: no gap between options, no shared border to collapse, and the wash is the point. `size` sizes the track, because a segmented item measures itself against it.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `'default' \| 'outline' \| 'segmented' \| 'solid'` |  |  |
| `size` | `ToggleSize` |  |  |
| `spacing` | `number` | `0` |  |

Also takes: bits-ui `ToggleGroup.Root` props.

### `ToggleGroupItem`

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `'default' \| 'outline' \| 'segmented' \| 'solid'` |  |  |
| `size` | `ToggleSize` |  |  |

Also takes: bits-ui `ToggleGroup.Item` props.
